facts.text: Plain `pi` is intercepted by the `pi()` zsh function in `.pi/config/tern-pi.zsh`. It runs `command node --experimental-strip-types "$runner"` only when there are no args, stdin and stdout are TTYs, `TERM_PROGRAM` is `tern`, `TERN_PANE` is set, `PI_TERN_UI` is not `0`, the runner is readable, and node exists. A leading `-nt` or any other case runs `command pi "$@"`.
`.pi/lib/tern/run.ts` falls back to native pi (`runNativePi`) when stdin is not a TTY or when no TSP hello reply arrives within 1s.

`.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` defines the owned block markers `# >>> trebol tern pi >>>` and `# <<< trebol tern pi <<<`. The block sources the dispatcher only under `case $- in *i*`. Setup accepts only darwin and linux, and zsh targets `$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc` or `~/.zshrc`.

`targetsForSetup` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` picks bash targets as `.bashrc` plus the first existing of `.bash_profile`, `.bash_login`, or `.profile`. It never creates a `.bash_profile` that would shadow an existing `.profile`. With no `.bashrc`, it uses only the existing profile file.

`editBlock` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` prepends the whole owned block on install, so uninstall restores all original bytes. It throws on a modified block, and refuses install when a user `pi` alias or function exists. A later user `pi` definition takes precedence.

`shellSetupState` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` returns `conflict` when any target has a modified block, when targets are split between installed and absent, or when a bash block sits outside the targets or `.zshrc.local` references the dispatcher.
`readSafe` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` refuses symlinks, non-regular files, and files over 1 MiB. A missing file is read as empty with mode 0600.

`setupShell` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-shell-setup.ts` preflights every target before writing. It writes each temp file with the original mode and `wx`, then re-reads and aborts if the file changed before the rename. On error it rolls back its own changed files in reverse order, skipping files whose content no longer matches its output.

`ternSetupWizard` in `.pi/lib/ui/tern-setup-wizard.ts` skips unless `ctx.mode` is `tui`, `ctx.hasUI` is set, stdin and stdout are TTYs, the shell is bash or zsh, the platform is darwin or linux, and both `.pi/config/tern-pi.zsh` and `.pi/lib/tern/run.ts` exist. It returns a manual-edit message on conflict and `already installed` for `startup` when installed. Otherwise it asks via `ctx.ui.confirm` before acting.

Tern runs with `hasUI=false`, so `ask_user_question` was dropped. The fix sets `remoteAsk = ctx.mode === "tui" && !interactive` in `extensions/swarm-transport-parity/extension.ts`. `swarm-tool-gating.ts` then keeps `ask_user_question` when `environment.remoteAsk` is set.
